detect_features_modalities: detect modalities from a datasets.Features object by classifying column types into audio, image, text, tabular, timeseries, or document
detect_modalities_from_features: detect dataset modalities from cached dataset-info step by parsing feature column types across all configs
detect_modalities_from_url_columns: detect image modalities by checking if split-image-url-columns previous step found URL columns pointing to images
detect_modalities_from_filetypes: detect dataset modalities from repository file extensions like image, audio, video, 3d, geospatial, text, and document types
compute_modalities_response: compute the full dataset-modalities response by combining feature, URL column, and file type detection methods into a sorted modality list
